sentences.text: Mr. Sudhanshu, learned counsel, has filed short counter affidavit along with his vakalatnama on behalf of the opposite party no.2 in the court today, which is taken on record.
Office is directed to register the same.
Heard Mr. Dhirendra Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicants, Mr. Sudhanshu, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Ms. Kirti Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants to quash the charge sheet dated 10.09.2022 as well as summoning order dated 29.09.2022 passed by learned Civil Judge Vivek Kumar Chaudhary And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164696917/
1 (J.D.)/F.T.C.-Ist, Varanasi and the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.216668 of 2022, arising out of Case Crime No.15 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station-Mahila Thana, District-Varanasi, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate-IIIrd, Varanasi, on the basis of application dated 26.06.2024 moved by opposite party no.2.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that opposite party no.2 has moved an application before the Court concerned along with an affidavit on 26.06.2024 stating therein that she does not want to proceed with the case but no appropriate orders have been passed by the Court concerned till date.
Therefore, a direction may be issued to the Court to decide the same within stipulated period.
Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has stated in his short counter affidavit filed today that opposite party no.2 does not want to proceed with the case.
Learned A.G.A. submits that he has no objection in case a direction is issued to the Court concerned to decide the matter within stipulated period.

In view of the above facts and circumstances of the case and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to pass appropriate orders on the aforesaid application of opposite party no.2, so filed, in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one month from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.

For the period of one month or till decision on the application moved by the opposite party no.2,
whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 Rahul.
